programme.desc: Documentary about the moment that would change the future of football. In 2004, with the internet still in its infancy, it only belatedly dawned on Argentina that 16-year-old Lionel Messi, who had broken through at FC Barcelona, ​​was on his way to obtaining Spanish nationality. A VHS tape of Messi's highlights was made and delivered to the Argentina association to make him an Argentina international. – Documentary about the moment that would change the future of football. programme.title: I was the king – Marcin Robak | S01E06
programme.desc: A series presenting the profiles of the best scorers in the history of the Premier League. This is a great opportunity to recall the successes of Włodzimierz Lubański, Grzegorz Lata, Kazimierz Kmiecik, Grzegorz Piechna and Tomasz Frankowski. We will get to know different football generations. In the 1960s, Włodzimierz Lubański (Górnik Zabrze) was the top scorer four times in a row. However, in the 1970s, Kazimierz Kmiecik (Wisła Kraków) and Grzegorz Lato (Stal Mielec) reigned supreme. In more modern times, Tomasz Frankowski won four titles in the colors of Wisła Kraków and Jagiellonia Białystok. There will also be the story of Grzegorz Piechna, the unexpected top scorer from Korona Kielce in 2006. Marcin Robak is a two-time top scorer in the Ekstraklasa. He is the last Pole to win this title so far. In total, he scored 120 goals in the top league. Marcin Robak scored 22 goals for Pogoń Szczecin in the 2013/2014 season. He finished the 2016/2017 season in Lech Poznań with 18 goals. He then had to share the crown with Marco Paixao. Poland. 2022-2025. documentary series

As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. Evolution Earth: Heat (S1E3). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. JAV, 2023. S1, Ep3
programme.desc: 2023 г. Год: 2023. Страна: JAV. Год: 2023. S1, Ep3 «Evolution Earth»…Go to extremes, from the Sahara to the outback, where animals are teaching us how to survive in our heating world. Shelter in caves with chimps, see camels sip salt water, and listen as zebra finches sing to their eggs to make their chicks smallerEvolution Earth embarks on a global expedition to reveal the animals keeping pace with a planet changing at superspeed. Heading out across the globe to distant wilds and modern urban environments, five episodes track how animals are moving, using ingenuity to adapt their behavior, and even evolving in unexpected ways. At the front lines of this rapid change are the scientists, filmmakers and local communities recording the animals' stories. We follow heart-warming tales of resilience that redefine our understanding of evolution, and hint at how nature can show us a path towards a sustainable future for Planet Earth. The series is narrated by Dr. Shane Campbell-Staton, who guides us through each episode in an intimate narrative style, drawing on his background as an evolutionary biologistDirector: Nick StringerCast: Shane Campbell-Staton

programme.title: Evolution Earth: Ice (S1E4). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. JAV, 2023. S1, Ep4
programme.desc: 2023 г. Год: 2023. Страна: JAV. Год: 2023. S1, Ep4 «Evolution Earth»…Trek to the planet's quickly melting poles, where animals are giving scientists clues about our future existence. Learn how the movements of polar bears, penguins, and other arctic creatures could help humans map (and prevent) global warmingEvolution Earth embarks on a global expedition to reveal the animals keeping pace with a planet changing at superspeed. programme.title: City Wildlife Rescue (S1E9). Documentary about nature. Canada, 2014. S1, Ep9
programme.desc: 2014 г. Год: 2014. Страна: Kanada. Год: 2014. S1, Ep9 «City Wildlife Rescue»…Follow an injured opossum into surgery, as the medical team realizes amputation may be the only way to save his badly injured toe. And meet some turtle hatchlings who seem ready for release when the team gets disappointing details about their sizeThis 12 part documentary series will show which animals actually live in the city, and what kind of trouble they encounter. When they do need help a rescue team is dispatched. Once rescued the animals are brought to this humble, but efficient, facility where a full time veterinarian is on hand. Problems are assessed, plans are put into action. Thousands of animals a year get a second chance at survival because of the dedicated volunteers and professionals who are united in their love of natureDirector: Sharone Ostrovski

programme.title: Life's Journey: Life's Lessons (S1E2). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Kanada, 2017. S1, Ep2
programme.desc: 2017 г. Год: 2017. Страна: Kanada. Год: 2017. S1, Ep2 «Life's Journey»…If young animals survive until adulthood, the chances for survival are greatly increased – but many challenges face them before they can strike out on their own. Some have months to grow-up; other have decades – but all, have lots to learn along the way. From getting to grips with their bodies and learning to feed themselves, to practicing fighting skills and learning how to form friendships. There are many hurdles along the way, but every small success could mean the difference between life and deathWith stunning fotage from the wilds of Africa, this three-part documentary series examines how the indigenous creatures of this fascinating continent deal with risk and danger when thay are at their most vulnerable and susceptible to attack. The show begins with how the parents of newborn animals defend them against the unwelcome attentions of predators when their young are expereincing the frightening realities of life for the very first time. As the offspring grow older, their place in the world is still uncertain with many obstacles to overcome before they reach the relative safety of adulthood. The final epsiode looks at the crucial mating rituals which ensure the survival of the speciesDirector: Hannah Hoare, Matthew ThompsonCast: Gillian Burke

programme.title: Wildlife ER: Nobody Likes Visiting the Dentist (S3E3). Documentary about nature. Australia, 2024. S3, Ep3
programme.desc: 2024 г. Год: 2024. Страна: Australija. Год: 2024. S3, Ep3 «Wildlife ER»…Head into surgery with Mara the koala, who needs a life-saving tooth operation, then assess an injured sugar glider with vet Tim. Cheer as rescue officer Elise pulls a flying fox out of a gutter and see nurse Bree's clutch of python eggs hatchFollows a range of dedicated professionals and volunteers as they look after unwell animals and carefully nurse them back to health at the RSPCA Wildlife Hospital in Brisbane, AustraliaDirector: Annie GrayCast: Justine Clarke

programme.title: Wildlife ER: Platypus Predicament (S3E4). Documentary about nature. Australia, 2024. S3, Ep4
programme.desc: 2024 г. Год: 2024. Страна: Australija. Год: 2024. S3, Ep4 «Wildlife ER»…Stand by as rescue officers use a technique called flagging to nab a koala with dangerously inflamed eyes. Soothe burned possum feet with vet Tim, then shadow vet Karina as she examines a half-drowned platypus before referring him to a specialistFollows a range of dedicated professionals and volunteers as they look after unwell animals and carefully nurse them back to health at the RSPCA Wildlife Hospital in Brisbane, AustraliaDirector: Annie GrayCast: Justine Clarke

programme.title: Uptown Otters: Queen of the Bay (S1E6). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Singapūras, 2022. S1, Ep6
programme.desc: 2022 г. Год: 2022. Страна: Singapūras. Год: 2022. S1, Ep6 «Uptown Otters»…Chase Anna to the Townies' lair, where Mia and her newborn pups are hiding out. See the babies' first swimming lessons before the clan moves to new digs, and welcome an era of otter peace as the Mangrove Family becomes a park's main attractionDirector: Claire Clements

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School: The Domino Effect (S2E1). Documentary about nature. England, 2019. S2, Ep1
programme.desc: 2019 г. Год: 2019. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2019. S2, Ep1 «Orangutan Jungle School»…Witness some big changes when four cute new arrivals join the nursery classes. And for a handful of adolescent males that are growing too big and boisterous for their babysitters, it's their last day at forest schoolCaptivating documentary series that follows the work of the Nyaru Menteng Orangutan Rescue Centre in Borneo, Indonesia, which is the largest orangutan rehabilitation centre in the world. People who work here are dedicated to rescuing orangutans that have been displaced from their habitat or kept as illegal pets, and they do their best to help them adjust and teach them the skills necessary to survive on their own when they return to the jungle. Hear some incredible stories and follow the antics, triumphs and tragedies of a group of orphaned orangutans as they go through «Orangutan Jungle School»Director: Simon Brown, Judith CurranCast: Rebecca Parr

programme.title: INSIGHT
programme.desc: Trên khắp Đông Nam Á, tỷ lệ kết hôn đang giảm. Ở Bangkok, một nửa cư dân ở đây là người độc thân. Ở Việt Nam, độ tuổi kết hôn ngày càng tăng lên. Vì sao giới trẻ không còn muốn kết hôn?
